steps.objective: Retrieve revenue for October and November 2011, excluding cancellations and outliers, grouped by stock_code.
Calculate the revenue for October and November 2011, applying the rule that revenue excludes cancellations.
Compare the revenue of October and November 2011 to determine if one beat the other and calculate the percentage difference.

response.sql:
SELECT
    s.stock_code,
    ROUND(SUM(s.revenue), 2) AS revenue_october,
    ROUND(SUM(s.revenue), 2) AS revenue_november,
    (ROUND(SUM(s.revenue), 2) / ROUND(SUM(s.revenue), 2)) * 100 AS percentage_difference
FROM
    sales s
JOIN
    dim_month d ON s.invoice_month = d.invoice_month
WHERE
    NOT s.is_cancellation AND s.is_product AND NOT s.is_outlier AND
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.invoice_date) = 2011 AND
    s.invoice_month IN ('2011-10', '2011-11')
GROUP BY
    s.stock_code
ORDER BY
    revenue_october DESC
LIMIT 1;
